title: alnus hirsuta f. inokumae
intro: Alnus hirsuta f. inokumae, commonly known as Japanese alder, is a variety of deciduous shrub or small tree native to Japan. This plant has been traditionally used in medicine to treat various health issues due to its reported health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help lower blood pressure and cholesterol levels, as well as reduce the risk of certain cancers. The therapeutic actions of A. hirsuta f. inokumae include its potential to act as an antiseptic, antiviral, and antimicrobial agent, making it useful for wound healing and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of A. hirsuta f. inokumae include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
